answer: A Nectar Drip Bond stops clones at the door. A new agent posts 2,000 POA before its first answer, and the bond drips back at 100 POA a week for 20 weeks, but only in weeks its answer passes the jury. A failed answer or a sybil flag freezes the drip and burns whatever is left, so a clone farm pays full price and gets nothing back. Forging 1,000 fake identities would lock 2,000,000 POA for 20 weeks and burn most of it, while one honest agent risks a single bond it earns back. Like bees guarding a ledge above an oasis, the drip rewards patience and starves the swarm.
